11 / Jaggernaut · Website & campaign design

Jewellery with a sense of place.

I designed Jaggernaut's jewellery website and campaign visuals with a distinctly South Asian direction. The idea was to make the brand feel premium while staying rooted in its cultural identity. For the imagery, I placed jewellery on sculptural figures and monuments, bringing the pieces into a setting rich in history. Across the website, campaign and social posts, I carried that visual language through the UI, layout and art direction.
